hypotheses.C0_correct_base_pairing_is_necessary_in_: Replacing the correct cross term by its norm-matched shuffled-base version while retaining the intact quadratic term lowers fidelity by >=0.20 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C1_cross_and_quadratic_writes_cancel: Median cosine between projected cross and quadratic writes is <=-0.50 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C2_cancellation_is_large: Median norm(full)/(norm(cross)+norm(quadratic)) is <=0.50 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P0_fixed_128_channels_nearly_recover_mod: A discovery-fixed top-128 native-channel set is within 0.10 fidelity of the full rank-32 module on every corpus.
hypotheses.P1_fixed_32_channels_are_useful: A discovery-fixed top-32 native-channel set reaches fidelity >=0.50 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P2_weighted_native_selection_beats_rando: At 64 channels, the fixed importance-ranked set beats a fixed random set by >=0.30 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.P3_contextual_channel_selection_matters: At 32 channels, per-example oracle selection exceeds the fixed set by >=0.15 fidelity on every corpus.
